description: Shows what applying to one job would send and use, and returns a single-use confirmation_token for apply_to_job. The user must review this preview and say yes in the conversation before apply_to_job; the token works for this job and this connection only and expires after 10 minutes. Sends nothing.

job_id.description: A job id from search_jobs, get_job_from_link or list_applications.

name: preview_application

confirmation_token.description: The single-use token apply_to_job takes for this job.

expires_in.description: How many seconds the token stays valid.

job.description: The job the application would go to.

salary.description: The pay the posting states, or null when it states none.

currency.description: ISO code of the stated pay.

max.description: Highest amount the posting states, in the currency's units.

min.description: Lowest amount the posting states, in the currency's units.

period.description: What the amounts are for (year, month, week, day or hour) when the posting states a period ApplySent recognizes.

match.description: The assessment of the job against the user.

missing.description: What the assessment could not establish about the user for this posting.

items.description: One fact the assessment could not establish.

reasons.description: Why the job scores what it does.

items.description: One reason the job scored as it did.

score.description: The match score against the user, from 0 to 100.

resume.description: Which résumé the application would attach, in words.

sends.description: What ApplySent would fill and submit, in words.

uses_applications.description: How many applications this send draws from the allowance.

title: Preview an application
